international.title: Eurovision organisers criticise Malaysian removal of LGBT+ footage in first Asian contest
international.summary: Broadcaster TV3 appears to cut footage of Thai drag performers and gay Philippine jury spokesperson Eurovision’s organisers have said they are “surprised and disappointed” that the first Eurovision Asia was altered when it was broadcast in Malaysia, apparently removing LGBTQ+ imagery and people from the show. The European Broadcasting Union (EBU), the alliance of public broadcasters that owns Eurovision, said it would write to Voxovation, the company producing the Asian contest under licence, and ask it to establish with the Malaysian broadcaster TV3 why it happened.
